name: tessera
description: Tessera: a bold, tile-built design system and React component library.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run build -w @tessera-design/react && npm run build -w @tessera-design/docs && npm run build -w @tessera-design/resume
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run build -w @tessera-design/react
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run dev -w @tessera-design/docs
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run test -w @tessera-design/react && npm run test -w @tessera-design/resume
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run typecheck -w @tessera-design/react && npm run typecheck -w @tessera-design/docs && npm run typecheck -w @tessera-design/resume
scripts.dev:resume: npm run build -w @tessera-design/tokens && npm run dev -w @tessera-design/resume
